item.title: Dothan experiencing phone system outage
item.description: DOTHAN, Ala (WDHN) -- The City of Dothan announced Wednesday afternoon that the city is experiencing a regional system outage. The city apologizes to residents for the inconvenience. WDHN will share updates as we receive them. UPDATE: While the city's phone system is temporarily inoperable, residents can still call emergency services like 911.
